summary_en: Etherscan added ERC-8004 support, making agent identity, reputation and discovery easier to see. Ethereal news #17 came out, led by frame transactions being CFI for Hegotá. SirSpudlington submitted tweaks to EIP-8141's default code for EIP-7392 compatibility. Two ethresear.ch posts appeared: block update digests without a global state tree, and leaderless BFT protocol design.
